shot.purpose: Homepage Made for little hands card
shot.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Create one new square editorial lifestyle photograph for Hey Kahani's homepage card "Made for little hands". Use the largest native square output available. This is a new candid scene in the approved photographic direction, not a collage or copy of a reference.

INPUT ROLES: image 1 is the Kahani Player product identity reference. Images 2 and 3 are approved PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE references for light, natural brown skin tones, tactile cotton and wood, playful colour, camera intimacy and domestic atmosphere. Do not reuse their exact children, poses or room.

SCENE: a 4-year-old Indian boy with deep warm brown skin, short slightly tousled black hair, a sky-blue short-sleeve cotton T-shirt and loose green cotton trousers sits on an ochre woven rug at a low wooden story shelf in a contemporary Indian family living room. He is quietly absorbed in choosing his own next story. His right fingertips gently lift one flat circular illustrated Koel disc by its rim from the shelf, while his left hand rests loosely on his own knee. One other circular story disc lies nearby; no piles. His gaze follows the disc with a small thoughtful smile, not a big advertising grin. A Kahani Player stands upright on the shelf just beside the discs, entirely visible and within the child's reach. Its top is empty, a blank circular recessed plate. A gently rumpled lavender cushion and blurred green fabric sofa provide a few playful domestic colours. No extra people. Keep the shelf, both hands, face, discs and complete Player comfortably inside the central 80% of the frame so the website's existing soft mask does not clip them. Background and rug can reach the edges. A natural three-quarter child-eye-height camera angle, 40mm equivalent feel, believable perspective and moderate depth of field. The child's expression, hands and the product are readable together, with soft window light from the side and gentle rich shadows. A moment of independent choice without help or demonstration.

PRODUCT LOCK: match image 1's cream/off-white cylindrical body, rounded top, arch carry handle, five separate white embossed circular controls in a cross (plus above; previous, play/pause, next across the middle; minus below), Gulab Red #D3000A woven fabric speaker band around the lower body, and thin light wood-toned base. Preserve product reference proportions, small tabletop scale and surface contact; do not make it a huge toy. No logo changes, no screen, no rectangular card slot. Koels are thin circular illustrated discs, never cards. Use simple illustrative animal or everyday story artwork without invented readable titles or branding. The empty top plate has no story art printed onto it; any cyan ring is small and subtle.

STYLE: same warm, candid, colourful everyday Indian childhood campaign as the style references. Natural skin texture, flyaway hair, real cotton creases, matte plastic and fabric weave. Warm light but believable neutral whites and no overall yellow filter. Controlled blue, green, ochre and lavender in textiles, natural wood, red only on the product band. Ordinary contemporary setting, no ceremonial clothing or decorative cultural props to signify nationality. Nobody looks at the camera or holds anything up to it.

AVOID: smooth waxy AI skin, generic stock-photo face, posed grin, exaggerated eyes, extra fingers, warped hands, floating discs, undersized or oversized product, missing handle, wrong controls, grey speaker band, all-red housing, competitor devices, rectangular cards, phones/tablets, glowing speaker, neon saturation, sepia grade, harsh flash, extreme bokeh, heavy film grain, spotless showroom. Full photographic frame with straight square edges, no baked mask, border, overlay text, watermark or collage.
